units.source_text: 从某种意义上说，过去我为什么竟如此相信老师的力量，并企国借助老师的力量呢？

en.t: In a certain sense, why had I once believed so strongly in the teacher's power, and even tried to rely on it?
I find it hard to explain clearly.

units.source_text: 再说，为什么我要把自己最后的决断，委请老师的驱逐呢？

en.t: Besides, why did I want to entrust my final decision to being expelled by the teacher?
I myself do not really understand it either.

units.source_text: 如前所述，我早就看透了老师的无能为力。

en.t: As I said before, I had long since seen through the teacher's helplessness.
